array.string:
PROJECT_ROOT="/Volumes/wdblack/some_project/QuantPyLab"; FALLBACK_LOG="$HOME/Library/Logs/QuantPyLab"; mkdir -p "$FALLBACK_LOG"; if [ ! -d "$PROJECT_ROOT" ]; then printf '%s project volume is not mounted
' "$(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')" >> "$FALLBACK_LOG/launcher.log"; exit 1; fi; if ! mkdir -p "$PROJECT_ROOT/logs"; then printf '%s project logs directory is unavailable
' "$(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')" >> "$FALLBACK_LOG/launcher.log"; exit 1; fi; cd "$PROJECT_ROOT" || exit 1; if ! exec >> "$PROJECT_ROOT/logs/launchd_sync-all.out.log" 2>> "$PROJECT_ROOT/logs/launchd_sync-all.err.log"; then printf '%s project log redirection failed
' "$(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')" >> "$FALLBACK_LOG/launcher.log"; exit 1; fi; exec "$PROJECT_ROOT/.venv/bin/python" "$PROJECT_ROOT/tools/schedule_sync_all.py"
